classification.difficultyReason: Identify the relevant part and whole in each situation, recognise that the population units already match, and convert each ratio to a percentage.

content.prompt: Express each of these situations as a percentage.

children.label: a
children.prompt: In a population of 24 million people, 0.06 million work in the automobile industry.

answer.worked:
Both quantities are expressed in millions.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage working in the automobile industry}&=\frac{0.06}{24}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage working in the automobile industry}&=\frac{6}{24}\%\\\text{Percentage working in the automobile industry}&=0.25\%\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: In a chess game, 5 out of 32 pieces were captured and removed from the board.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage of pieces captured}&=\frac{5}{32}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage of pieces captured}&=\frac{125}{8}\%\\\text{Percentage of pieces captured}&=15\frac{5}{8}\%\end{align*}$$
